reclassification: v2's scientific result is retained. v3 only strengthens the pre-registered validation contract with genuine two-page positive jobs, persistent short-domain enumeration, and a final deadline check; it does not add a key, parameter, score, or LP2 decision rule.
basis: C017 records exact known-page evidence that plaintext F can be copied without advancing a clock, while ordinary encryption can also produce ciphertext F.
H016-v2 corrected the empty-positive, cross-page-count, and status-classification defects in v1, but its positive jobs were still one-page jobs.

Astra's audit identified the remaining validation boundary: the worker/orchestrator must be exercised on genuinely split pages, and the promised short-path enumeration must be a persistent regression rather than an ad hoc check.
hypothesis: The fixed FIRFUMFERENFE subtractive repeating-key model remains compatible with LP2 when plaintext F is an exception copied without consuming the 13-position key clock; unknown ciphertext F positions must retain both legal inverse transitions, including their capped path multiplicities across page boundaries.
falsifiable_predictions: Each of four verifier-only synthetic jobs (two plaintext plans times page-reset and continuous branches) is split into two public pages, and its generating path reaches the independently reconstructed endpoint on every page.

The preregistered incompatible ciphertext [1,10] has no terminal state from phase 0 because the second symbol would decode to forbidden plaintext F at key phase 1; its first death position is zero-based 1.
All 55 applicable LP2 pages are evaluated under page-reset and numeric-order continuous branches; a complete control set and maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 are required for a statistic lead.
A page with a surviving terminal state is model compatibility evidence only. It is never accepted as a decrypted page without an independent plaintext or structural prediction.

sources.role: Previous corrected specification and unchanged scientific model/statistical contract.
Previously frozen public key and source basis.
Pinned LP2 raw corpus and page applicability.
C017 known-page exception evidence and prior experiment index.

applicable_objects: All 55 pages containing registered rune tokens, including rune portions of mixed literal pages LP2/49 and LP2/51.

excluded_objects.reason: Pinned source has no registered rune tokens; its literal alphanumeric grid is outside this rune-domain state model and is unexecuted, not negative.

representation: Original rune ordinal indices 0..28 only; all non-rune characters remain outside the public state sequence and are not silently deleted or rewritten.

key.label: FIRFUMFERENFE
key.phase_domain: r in 0..12; consuming a normal transition advances r modulo 13

state_model.normal_transition: Forward-enumerate plaintext p=1..28 as C=(p+K[r]) mod29; inverse transitions are legal only for those outputs and consume one key phase.
state_model.plaintext_f_exception: Plaintext F is p=0, emits ciphertext 0 without consuming the key phase. For ciphertext 0, retain this edge together with the ordinary non-F edge when one exists.
state_model.merge: Merge states with equal processed position and phase; carry capped path multiplicity per phase with cap 2 across continuous page boundaries.
state_model.literals: Non-rune characters do not enter the state sequence and do not consume phase.

classification.compatible: A non-empty initial state has at least one terminal path after all runes in the reached page.
classification.dead: A non-empty initial state loses every path at a rune; first_dead_position is zero-based and legal_prefix_length equals that position.
classification.not_reached: A continuous page begins with no state because an earlier page killed the continuous prefix; no rune in this page contributes to the prefix metric.

algorithm_version: H016-v3: H016-v2 state model plus two-page positive orchestration checks, persistent short-domain exhaustive regression, and final deadline audit; no key search, skip-mask search, dictionary, language completion or output-selected exception set.

statistics.metric: Longest legal prefix ratio per page-reset page and for the complete continuous corpus; a complete reached path has ratio 1.0. Not-reached page ratios are null and excluded from the continuous prefix accumulation.
statistics.units: 55 page-reset units plus 1 continuous whole-corpus unit; continuous downstream pages after an empty prefix are classified not_reached, not as independent negatives.
statistics.maxT: Standardize observed and 999 control metric vectors together; compare each observed unit with the maximum control z across all 56 units using plus-one p and fixed tie tolerance 1e-12.
statistics.statistic_status: lead when complete controls yield maxT-adjusted p<=0.01; not_detected otherwise; zero_variance is reported separately.
statistics.candidate: Only a unit that is both model_status=compatible and statistic_status=lead is listed as an unsolved-page candidate. A statistical lead on a dead prefix is not a candidate.
statistics.overall_status: With complete controls and passed verification, report inconclusive if any reached page is compatible or any statistic lead exists; otherwise report negative for this exact frozen model and null. Never call a surviving state a decryption.

controls.random_null: For every applicable page, keep ciphertext-F positions fixed and uniformly shuffle only the multiset of nonzero rune values among the remaining positions; preserve page length, page order and page boundaries. Each replicate supplies one joint 56-unit vector.
controls.synthetic_positive: Verifier-only deterministic two-page plaintexts include copied plaintext F and a nonzero plaintext whose fixed-key normal encryption produces ciphertext F. Continuous jobs encrypt the concatenated plaintext before splitting; page-reset jobs encrypt each page independently. Expected plaintext, traces and endpoints are never passed to the worker.
controls.impossible_control: Public one-page ciphertext [1,10] must have no terminal state from phase 0 and must die at zero-based position 1.
controls.independent: A separate verifier builds a complete 13x29 ciphertext transition table by forward-enumerating p=0..28, recomputes every state summary and capped count, checks every synthetic page endpoint, and checks the impossible control. The permanent regression exhausts every ciphertext sequence of lengths 0 through 3 over F29 and compares uncapped brute-force counts after applying the same cap.

randomness.role: Observed/control page permutations only; never passed to worker and never used as key or plaintext seed. Checkpoints retain replicate IDs, partial rows, hashes and replay state digests.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner writes specification, source/data hashes, public ciphertext jobs, verifier-only expected paths, code snapshot and control seed before invoking the guarded worker or calculating control statistics.
independent_validation_path: The worker uses lp_lab.periodic_f_state_v2's guarded inverse recurrence. The orchestrator uses a forward-enumerated direct transition table and separate recurrence, with exact field-by-field comparison, two-page private positive-path checks and a public impossible control.

validation_contract.deadline_guard: Monotonic checks are recorded immediately before and after final source verification once statistics are written; elapsed >=120 seconds is timeout, statistics are marked accepted=false, and the run is never negative.

timeout_policy: A single 120-second monotonic deadline covers worker execution, observations, controls and final statistics. The worker receives only the remaining time. Every completed replicate is appended to a partial JSONL file; an atomically replaced checkpoint records the completed count, partial hash, frozen hash, seed, replay rule and RNG-state digest. Timeout never becomes negative.

total_budget.state_transition_upper_bound: At most two outgoing transitions per reachable phase and rune; no complete exception-mask enumeration.

uncovered_parameters: Other keys, directions, offsets, periods and key derivations
Other F policies, unknown literal/grid consumption and alternative page orders
Feedback/autokey, multiplicative projections, PGL transforms and geometry
Independent LP2 plaintext, image-level glyph audit and LP2/50 literal grid
next_step: If a compatible unit also has a statistic lead, register an independent plaintext or structural prediction before interpretation. Otherwise retain the compatibility/dead map and move to a new method family; do not tune H016 parameters after observing LP2.
note: This is a finite-state compatibility diagnostic, not a plaintext search or decryption claim. v2 remains an independent prior result; v3 is the strengthened validation batch.
